profile_name: Bambu Lab A1 mini - single material PLA - 0.4 mm nozzle
startup_source: Bambu Studio A1 mini machine_start_gcode and machine_end_gcode templates, compiled by installed Bambu Studio from its PLA Basic / Textured PEI profiles.
notes: Uses A1 mini startup and shutdown, 180 mm build limits and X90 Y90 centering. MAP retains its conservative 30 mm/s print, 150 mm/s travel and 500 mm/s2 acceleration defaults. This profile does not define or certify a fitted nonplanar tool envelope.
